assessment.nobel_worthiness: Very distinctive visionary voice. Blinding (the Orbitor trilogy) and Solenoid build dense, hallucinatory prose from memory, the body and metaphysical speculation, and the formal ambition is sustained across volumes. Poetry and essays are part of the same project. The imaginative and intellectual depth is high, and the work is recognizable as nothing else.
assessment.attribution: Single writer, with a citation scope centered on the large-scale prose cosmology of the novels and a more secondary poetic base. The citation would need to cover his place in Romanian and European literature without reducing him to a generic 'postmodern' label.
assessment.maturity: A long career with major works spanning several decades and an established international reception. The late novels continue the earlier project, so the timing is plausible.
uncertainties: Much of the density and musicality of the Romanian prose depends on translation, and I cannot independently judge how well it carries over.
Coverage of the poetry and early work in translation is uneven, and I have not verified the corpus.
The longest works are demanding, and their durability as a whole is a judgment call.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: An uncompromising, original narrative method. Dream logic, estranged psychology and the abandonment of conventional causality are carried through story collections and novels with great consistency. The voice is highly distinctive and the formal achievement is real. Her work gives an unusual account of consciousness and social space.
assessment.attribution: Single writer. The citation would concern a radically experimental fiction in Chinese, partly in dialogue with Western modernists but not derivative of them. Representative works are Frontier and Love in the New Millennium, which sit within a very large body of short fiction.
assessment.maturity: More than four decades of sustained, consistent production. Quality across such a large output is hard to judge from translations alone.
uncertainties: Only a part of her output is available in English or other translations, so coverage of the corpus is incomplete.
The uniformity of method may be read as either rigor or repetition.
Whether the effect of the Chinese prose survives translation is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remakes the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, essay, translation and visual form. Autobiography of Red and Nox show formal invention and emotional force together. The voice is unmistakable and the intellectual depth is considerable.
assessment.attribution: Single writer. The citation would rest on hybrid poetic forms and on the renewal of classical material, within the poetry-centered tradition in English. Her scholarly and translation work is part of the case but should not substitute for the literary achievement.
assessment.maturity: A body of work developed over decades and highly regarded. Some of the work is deliberately minor in scale, and sustained major-form achievement is harder to weigh than for novelists.
uncertainties: The formal ingenuity may be weighed differently against the emotional range of the work.
The breadth of the oeuvre is difficult to assess because the books are so varied and often short.
Her relation to Nobel's phrase about an ideal direction is open to interpretation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Compressed, intensely worked French prose that turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are widely discussed as achievements of language and form. The voice is very distinctive.
assessment.attribution: Single writer. The citation would focus on the 'fictions of lives' and prose of exceptional density. The oeuvre is small by volume, which affects how its scope is framed.
assessment.maturity: The work is of consistently high quality, but the oeuvre is slim. It may be judged as concentrated rather than broad.
uncertainties: Michon's style is difficult to translate, and the quality of the existing translations is uncertain to me.
The relatively small body of work may limit the scope of significance a committee will accept.
I have not independently verified the full bibliography.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Uncanny, precise narration of exclusion, family power and unstable belonging. Three Strong Women and My Heart Hemmed In show a controlled strangeness that is formally assured. The plays extend the range of the work.
assessment.attribution: Single writer. The citation would address fiction and drama in French that use the fantastic to examine social and psychological reality. Her particular position in contemporary French writing is a relevant but secondary element.
assessment.maturity: An established career from the late 1980s with consistent quality, though relatively young by the standard of long careers.
uncertainties: Her age and career stage may make the case seem early relative to other candidates.
Coverage of her theatre in translation is limited.
Whether she will appear to have a lasting formal influence is hard to say.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major reshaping of modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with the inherited tradition. His poetry and critical writing are widely taken to have changed the field. The achievement is significant in terms of both language and idea.
assessment.attribution: Single writer, with a citation scope on poetry and poetic theory in Arabic. Because his work is also tied to cultural and political debate, the literary case has to be kept distinct from those associations.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with a large body of work, and a reputation that is already well established.
uncertainties: The achievement lies in the Arabic language, and I cannot independently assess how much translation preserves.
The poetry's reception in translation is uneven.
Political and cultural associations should not stand in for literary judgment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative prose and moral interiority bring theology, family and American history together. Housekeeping and Gilead are works of marked stylistic clarity and depth, and the voice is clearly her own. The essays add intellectual weight.
assessment.attribution: Single writer, with a citation scope covering fiction and essays in English. The novel oeuvre is small, so the case rests on the quality of a few major works plus the essays.
assessment.maturity: Mature and consistent, though the novel output is limited in volume. The Gilead sequence extends the achievement.
uncertainties: The small number of novels may limit the sense of breadth.
Whether the formal range is wide enough is a matter of judgment.
The reception of the essays is more mixed and not fully assessed here.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A hybrid of travel writing, essay and fiction that maps Europe through borderlands, memory and intellectual history. Danube and Microcosms are significant for their formal blending and their breadth of cultural knowledge. The achievement rests on erudition as well as voice.
assessment.attribution: Single writer. The citation would concern a Central European literary and essayistic project in Italian. The hybrid genre makes it harder to define whether the case is for fiction, essay or both.
assessment.maturity: A long, consistent career with a well-established reputation. Some of the late work is less discussed internationally.
uncertainties: The genre mix could complicate how the citation is framed within Nobel's wording on literature.
I cannot independently judge the Italian prose, and the translations may not fully represent it.
The novelistic work is less widely known than the essays.
